verdict.rationale: First-party docs show HMAC-signed webhooks for payment, balance and dispute events. Webhooks can be managed through the Dashboard or API, and there is a documented resend capability plus Amazon EventBridge delivery, which covers signing and replay. The pack does not document automatic retry behaviour or a browsable webhook event/delivery log, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented automatic webhook retry policy, webhook event/delivery logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
